description: Berger Paints Pakistan Limited has manufactured paints and coatings in Pakistan since 1950, when it began supplying a market newly independent of imported paint. It established its first local manufacturing facility in Karachi in 1955 and in 2006 opened a manufacturing plant and head office in Lahore, supported by regional sales offices in Karachi, Islamabad and Multan. The company describes its range as covering both home and large-scale commercial painting, and emphasises durability, coverage and environmental responsibility in its products.
